notes.title: COSMONAUT becomes Free-to-Play Jan. 1, 2020!
notes.content:
Greetings from Neon Chasm!

COSMONAUT will become Free-to-Play by January 1st, 2020.

We sincerely thank all those who supported us by purchasing the game over the past two years. It is our hope this change will allow the game to be enjoyed by as many players as possible.

Happy Holidays,
Brian / Neon Chasm

notes.title: COSMONAUT Original Soundtrack Update!
notes.content:
The COSMONAUT Original Soundtrack is now included with each game purchase at no additional charge:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31482134/19db05d174e4138a5dae8a4646e478a26a8a321a.jpg[/img]

01. (1:26) Menu Theme
02. (1:39) Crossing the Rubicon
03. (2:15) Prologue Ship
04. (1:02) Tetherless
05. (2:14) The Chasm's Edge
06. (1:34) Glass House
07. (2:13) Sanctuary
08. (1:29) S I M O N
09. (3:01) A Journey's End

(Approx. 17 minutes in length)

Access Instructions:
Go to steam library -> right-click "COSMONAUT" -> choose "properties" -> choose "BROWSE LOCAL FILES..." -> See sub-folder "COSMONAUT Original Soundtrack"

Enjoy!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: The best five unsung games on Steam this week
notes.content:
Studies say that this week is the best week of the year to move house for gillionth time, attempt the thirteenth Herculean task of speaking to the one human in a Royal Mail call centre, then injure your back. Anti-frustration, then, would be a perfect theme for this week’s Unknown Pleasures.

Washing down an inadequate course of ibuprofen this week: artificial mortality, shotgun-based exploration, and zero gravity monster-dodging.

(more…)
